# VoltViz

> VoltViz is a free, open-source (MIT) real-time music visualizer that runs in the browser: feed it your system audio, a microphone, or a Music Assistant stream (via Sendspin) and pick from 50+ visualizations — bars, spheres, tunnels, particle systems, festival stages, retro CRT/Winamp/Win95 skins and more, rendered with Canvas, WebGL and three.js. No account, no ads, no paid features.

VoltViz is a single-page app with exactly one page (/). Visualizers are chosen
in-app or via URL parameters (`viz`, `sensitivity`, `speed`, `hueShift`,
`scale`, `skin`, `sendspin`); there are no separate article pages to index.

It is also available as a Home Assistant add-on and as a Docker image
(ghcr.io/sanderdw/voltviz).
